sections.title: Non-residents: employment income (begrænset skattepligt)

rows.label: Who has limited tax liability
rows.value: Someone who lives abroad and works in Denmark; Danish pay is taxed in Denmark. A daily commuter from a home abroad (e.g. Sweden or Germany) never becomes fully tax liable, however long the work lasts

rows.label: Residence test: fully tax liable when
rows.value: A year-round home is available in Denmark, or the person stays in Denmark for more than 6 months without going home
